title: QR Code Beautifier

contentPlaceholder: Enter a URL, text, or any content...
emptyHint: Enter content to generate a QR code
tip1: A high error correction level lets you add a larger logo while the QR code stays scannable even when partially covered
tip2: Keep the logo size under 1/3 of the QR code to avoid affecting scan reliability
tip3: Make sure the foreground and background colors have enough contrast for reliable scanning
tip4: The generated QR code can be downloaded directly or copied to the clipboard
